onboarding.welcomeBody: Each day BeWise picks a quote for you and sets it on a beautiful photo. Ten seconds to read, a whole day to carry.
onboarding.themeTitle: What do you need to hear?
onboarding.themeBody: Pick a theme for your daily quote. You can change it anytime in Themes.
onboarding.reminderBody: Get a quiet reminder to read your quote at the time that suits you.
onboarding.widgetTitle: Keep it on your home screen
onboarding.widgetBody: Add the BeWise widget to see today’s quote and its photo without opening the app.
onboarding.widgetIos: Touch and hold your Home Screen, tap Edit, then Add Widget and search for BeWise. Customize your Lock Screen to add it there too.
onboarding.widgetAndroid: Touch and hold your home screen, tap Widgets, then find BeWise.
onboarding.widgetWeb: On iPhone and Android, add the BeWise widget to your home screen.
onboarding.sampleQuote: The best way to get started is to quit talking and begin doing.
